target_artist_ids=set(unique_artists.keys())
following_artist_ids=set(following_artists.keys())
missing_ids=sorted(list(target_artist_ids-following_artist_ids))
print('target_artist_count',len(target_artist_ids))
print('following_artist_count',len(following_artist_ids))
print('missing_count',len(missing_ids))
print('missing_artists',[(i, unique_artists[i]) for i in missing_ids])

results=[]
for aid in missing_ids:
    try:
        r=apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
        results.append((aid,'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((aid,'fail',str(e)))
print('follow_results_ok', [x[0] for x in results if x[1]=='ok'])
print('follow_results_fail', [ (x[0],x[2]) for x in results if x[1]=='fail'])

# verify following status
verify=[]
for aid in missing_ids:
    try:
        v=apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
        verify.append((aid, v))
    except Exception as e:
        verify.append((aid, 'error', str(e)))
print('verify', verify)
